title: feat(spec): a stored view filter list can hold an any-of group
body:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Fixes #28020

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已保存视图的筛选列表（`ListView.filter`、视图页签、页面 `filterBy`、数据源与相关列表等）原来只能写"全部满足"的平铺规则，现在可以多放一种元素 `{ any: [规则, ...] }`，表示"满足其中任意一条"；只允许一层，列表本身仍是"并且"。
- 为什么改：业务上最常见的"未完成，或最近 7 天内完成"这类视图以前无法保存，只能拆成两个视图；现在可以作为一个视图存下来。
- 风险与回滚：今天已保存的每个筛选解析结果逐字节不变（接受的输出相同，拒绝的报错码/路径/文案相同）；控制台尚未应用该分组（已标 `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`，由 #28370 跟进），存了分组的视图暂时不会按它过滤；回滚只需还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` 中的 `ViewFilterAnyGroupSchema` / `ViewFilterElementSchema`，以及钉住全部要求的 `packages/spec/src/ui/view-filter-any-group.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/view-filter-any-group.test.ts`，再跑 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/filter-walk-any-group.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：请裁定这一存储形状（列表中一层 any-of 分组），并批准键名 `any`；另请确认蓝图（solution-blueprint）的 `filters` 保持平铺规则、相关列表的 UI 镜像暂不放开分组这两处取舍。

Independent review: none run (quota); the PR waits for the seat's contract-review hand-off.

## What changes

- **Spec (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`).** A view filter list now holds `ViewFilterElementSchema` = `ViewFilterRuleSchema | ViewFilterAnyGroupSchema`. The group is `{ any: [rule, ...] }`: a strict object whose only key is `any`, a non-empty array of `ViewFilterRuleSchema` itself, so the operator vocabulary, the legacy-alias fold, the operator/value coupling and the `icontains` comparand check all apply inside a group as at the top level. One level only.
- **Key spelling `any`.** No at-rest any-of spelling exists to mirror. The console builder's `{ id, logic: 'and'|'or', conditions }` is editing state: its `and` arm repeats the list's own AND, so `logic` would have exactly one legal value, and `id` is a UI row key. `$or` on views is out of bounds (no `FilterConditionSchema` admitted). `{ any: [...] }` says the semantics in the key and leaves nothing to agree with.
- **Byte-identical for stored filters.** The element union carries a check (the same pattern as `focusClaimedBranch` on `ViewMetadataSchema`) that reports only the branch the element claims, so a refused flat rule shows exactly the issues it showed before, not an `invalid_union`.
- **Refusals.** Empty group: `too_small` at `filter.N.any`. Nested group: `unrecognized_keys` naming `any` on the inner element, with guidance. A non-rule member, a non-array `any`, or a rule key beside `any` are refused. `$or`, `or`, `anyOf`, `logic` and `conditions` written on a rule are answered with the group shape.
- **Carriers.** Every carrier that held `z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema)` moved: `ListView.filter`, `ViewTab.filter`, the three page carriers (`ElementDataSource.filter`, record binding filter, `InterfacePageConfig.filterBy`) and the eleven component doors. A source-scan pin holds that set. The one exception is `BlueprintViewSchema.filters` (`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`): the model writes it through a strict mirror that cannot carry a union, and its applier lives outside this repo. A comment there says so.
- **Readers.** Updated: `@objectstack/lint` `filter-walk.ts` (list-view, dataset and widget field-reference rules), `validate-preset-comparands.ts`, and `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` (`filterBy`, the related-list `filter`). `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `computeViewReferenceDiagnostics` reads preset-tab filters. Checked and unchanged: `graftNormalizedOperators` (structural, now pinned through a group), `validate-field-consumers` (generic walk, already credits fields inside a group) and `validate-empty-combinators`. Marked `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`: every console reader that turns the list into a query (plugin-list `buildEffectiveFilter`, core `convertFiltersToAST`, data-objectstack `objectFilterEntriesToAST`, app-shell `viewFilterFold`, plugin-view `parseSpecFilter`). No server-side reader in `packages/` does that, so the group carries the PLANNED tag in its describe, TSDoc and `liveness/view.json`.
- **Follow-up.** The console half is filed as **#28370** (domain:ui, `finding`). It lands after this PR.
- Prose that said `$or` cannot be written in a rule array (`filter-rule-array.ts`, `conversions/registry.ts`) now names the group.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view-filter-any-group.test.ts` (new) covers:
  - a group is accepted on ListView, ViewTab, ElementDataSource and InterfacePageConfig;
  - stored flat rules, accepted and refused, parse identically as an element and as a bare rule;
  - refinements apply inside a group;
  - refusals: empty, nested, a non-rule member, a non-array `any`, a stray rule key, the OR spellings;
  - the wire `id` strip inside a group, and the authoring refusal of `id`;
  - JSON-schema `anyOf`, the `isViewFilterAnyGroup` predicate, and a carrier source scan.
- `packages/lint/src/filter-walk-any-group.test.ts` (new), plus cases in `validate-page-field-bindings.test.ts` and `validate-preset-comparands.test.ts`: a field inside a group is checked at `…[0].any[1]…`, and `any` is never reported as a field.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.view-filter-any-group.test.ts` (new): diagnostics through a group, and the operator graft through a group.
- `ui/packages/types` type-parity pins move to `ViewFilterElement[]`. The two related-list mirrors are pinned as "the contract minus the group" plus "the contract also takes the group". `record-components.ts` stays flat because widening it reaches plugin-detail prop types, which belong to #28370.

## Acceptance notes

- Shape A: one group element, one level, inside the existing list. No `$or`, no `FilterConditionSchema` on views.
- `solution-blueprint` view `filters` stay flat (strict mirror, applier out of repo). That call is the seat's to confirm.
- The related-list UI mirror (`ui/packages/types/src/record-components.ts`) deliberately lags the contract by the group, with pins that hold the lag exactly. Widening it is #28370's job.
- The conversion registry does not write groups: converting a stored `$or` record into a group would widen that conversion, so it is left as is.
- The group is `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` until #28370: a view that stores one saves and validates but does not narrow its rows yet.

## Verification

- Post-merge (tree at the head of this PR):
  - `@objectstack/spec`: 773 files / 22857 tests passed;
  - targeted lint tests: 4 files / 263 tests passed;
  - metadata-protocol: 1 file / 3 tests passed.
- Pre-merge full suites:
  - lint: 183 files / 7693 tests, typecheck passed;
  - metadata-protocol: 285 files, typecheck passed;
  - ui type-check over spec dependents: green after the pin moves (`@object-ui/types`, plugin-detail);
  - ui pin tests: 6 files / 184 tests passed.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 110 derived commands, each run with its exit code recorded, then reconciled with `--ran`. The result: 110 run, 110 exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Two gates (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`) first exited 3 (prerequisite not met, unbuilt dist). Both were rerun green after building `@objectstack/client-react` and then the full workspace (`turbo run build`, 116/116 tasks). `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:nul-bytes` also pass.
- `gen:schema`, `gen:docs`, `check:generated -- --fix` (all artifacts current), `check:liveness` and `check:authorable-surface` all pass.
